rulings: 2026-08-14: machines are game versions over the shared HelmCortex/DotCortex overworld; scopes are catch locations, never regions (supersedes the 2026-08-02 scope-to-region draft)

2026-08-31: role field added (hub/client/companion) — the single machine-readable source of each machine's fleet role for the Fleet Nervous System session lane and the P2 router; kikin-kushi=hub (the t1700 fileserver), ThinkPads=client, S24=companion. A machine matches its own hostname against a row to learn its role; unknown host defaults to client (the safe role — never crawls the brain tree, never writes the shared index).
2026-09-23: emergency hub cutover sets x230=hub and kikin-kushi=client; the historical 2026-08-31 role ruling above records the former topology.
2026-09-23: hub identity changes only through the guarded hx-hub-switchover state machine; exactly one machine row is hub and it must agree with the fleet-router transport.

2026-09-24: Honey (Gillean's Beelink, sealed Crystal 2026-08-26 msgs 874/876) joins as a client-zone row. Key and hostnames match the Pokédex compatibility entry; ssh_alias is beelink because that is the alias the hub resolves to Honey. Its capture row is ownership-scoped: only sessions bound to consorts the scope gazetteer records as owner=metsatron are ever captured (services-fleet-router.org).
